info.name: Gets available time slots on a calendar

params.description: External system id of person making the request

params.name: provider_id
params.description: Rokwire provider id of the organization tracking/providing appointment data

params.name: unit_id
params.description: External id identifying the unit the calendar entries belong to

params.name: person_id
params.description: External id identifying the advisor the calendar entry belongs to

params.name: start_time
params.description: The first date to look for available slots (yyyy-mm-dd). Required if end_time is provided.

params.name: end_time
params.description: The last date to look for available slots (yyyy-mm-dd) Required if start_time is provided
